name: com.jd.ad.sdk.bl.adinteraction.deeplink.JADWebViewActivity
description: Jingdong (JD Ads) opens this screen when an ad landing link should appear in an in-app browser. It loads the advertiser’s page and sends supported links to Android or another app.
disableEffect: JD Ads’ in-app landing pages will not open; other app screens continue to work.
